data.title: 天雨亚子 · 风纪委办公室的通宵校对
data.description: 歌赫娜风纪委员会高层办公室，深夜的台灯照亮了堆积如山的通报公文。亚子身着端庄严整的露胸风纪制服，神情专注而微带疲倦，修长玉指按在文件页边缘。她抬头望向进门的老师，湛蓝眼眸中带着严苛与悄然松口气的反差神采。
data.action: leaning over mahogany desk, checking paperwork, serious yet relieved expression
data.lighting: focused warm desk lamp glow with deep shadows in the background
data.promptProse: Working late at her vast mahogany office desk at Gehenna Prefect Team headquarters, Amau Ako leans forward with documents in hand, her blue eyes fixed forward in stern dedication.
data.animaCaption: Ako working sternly over paperwork in her headquarters office.
